# Welcome to Zumtobel

# Zumtobel

## Innovative LED lighting solutions and lighting management

**Zumtobel, a leading international supplier of integral lighting solutions, enables people to
experience the interplay of light and architecture. As a leader in innovation, Zumtobel provides a
comprehensive range of high-quality LED luminaires and lighting management systems for professional
interior lighting in the areas of offices, education, presentation & retail, hotel & wellness,
health, art & culture as well as industry.**

**We provide everyone with the best light that we all enjoy so much **
For over 60 years, the Zumtobel brand has been synonymous with innovation, unique product and
service quality as well as superior design and sustainability. Zumtobel reconciles lighting quality
and energy efficiency and develops customised lighting solutions that provide measurable added
value. We cater individually for your requirements and users' needs, always keeping in mind the
result of supplying the best light for people and the environment.

Zumtobel can make a significant contribution towards achieving environmental certification of
buildings?

# Welcome to Zumtobel

# Zumtobel

## Innovative LED lighting solutions and lighting management

**Zumtobel, a leading international supplier of integral lighting solutions, enables people to
experience the interplay of light and architecture. As a leader in innovation, Zumtobel provides a
comprehensive range of high-quality LED luminaires and lighting management systems for professional
interior lighting in the areas of offices, education, presentation & retail, hotel & wellness,
health, art & culture as well as industry.**

**We provide everyone with the best light that we all enjoy so much **
For over 60 years, the Zumtobel brand has been synonymous with innovation, unique product and
service quality as well as superior design and sustainability. Zumtobel reconciles lighting quality
and energy efficiency and develops customised lighting solutions that provide measurable added
value. We cater individually for your requirements and users' needs, always keeping in mind the
result of supplying the best light for people and the environment.

Did you know that ...

buildings?

[Aputure at BIRTV Beijing]
[BIRTV Beijing][29]
From illuminating light and shadow to defining the future. In 2025, we opened a new chapter in LED
point-source technology for film and television with our proprietary BLAIR and BLAIR-CG light
engines. In 2026, we will launch an update to our light engine technology, delivering optical
solutions that revolutionize performance at the source and eliminate the trade-off between
brightness and color. This year also marks a major upgrade to our intelligent control ecosystem and
the debut of an all-new product line. A spectacular showcase of light and shadow awaits, don't miss
it! We look forward to welcoming you!
8/19/2026
[Aputure at IBC Amsterdam]
[IBC Amsterdam][30]
Discover how Aputure's expanding ecosystem of professional lighting solutions is transforming
broadcast, live production, film, and studio workflows. Rather than showcasing individual products,
our booth demonstrates complete production environments, highlighting the seamless integration of
the STORM and NOVA series with Sidus Link Pro for intelligent, network-based lighting control.
Explore the Sidus Playground to experience advanced lighting workflows firsthand, see real-world
applications throughout the booth, and be among the first to discover exciting new additions to the
Aputure lineup that further expand our professional lighting ecosystem.

Since 2003, BulbAmerica has been striving to offer customers the best selection of lighting products
on the internet, along with competitive prices and personalized service you won't find anywhere
else. Our premium light bulbs, fixtures and other lighting products are shipped quickly, being
delivered right to your door in very little time. We're proud of our huge selection of lighting
products, but we're just as proud of the personalized service we offer each and every customer. If
you have a question, you can get a prompt, reliable answer from our courteous and knowledgeable
staff simply by calling us toll-free or by emailing us. That's why BulbAmerica is your one-stop
light bulbs online shop for LED lighting, Stage Bulbs, Automotive Bulbs, Christmas Lights, light
bulbs, fixtures and much more.

Whether you're looking for lamp light bulbs, a stage light bulb, an automotive lamp or any other
kind of light bulb, we probably have it, because we carry more than 50,000 types of bulbs. With
worldwide shipping available, we can get your bulb to you no matter where you call home. We carry
all of the leading brands like Osram and General Electric as well as our own economical BulbAmerica
house brand. If you're into saving money, you should also check out our vast selection of LED bulbs,
which are designed to save energy compared to standard incandescent and compact fluorescent bulbs,
thereby lowering operating costs. LED bulbs are also long-lasting, saving you money on labor and
maintenance costs.

At BulbAmerica, we carry the best selection of fixtures, bulbs, accessories and other lighting
equipment for all sorts of applications. Whether you're looking for lighting for commercial
industrial, residential or theatrical needs, you'll find the right bulb and accessories at
BulbAmerica. Are you a DJ looking to take your show on the road? Consider some of our lightweight,

you have a question, you can get a prompt, reliable answer from our courteous and knowledgeable
staff simply by calling us toll-free or by emailing us. That's why BulbAmerica is your one-stop
light bulbs online shop for LED lighting, Stage Bulbs, Automotive Bulbs, Christmas Lights, light
bulbs, fixtures and much more.

kind of light bulb, we probably have it, because we carry more than 50,000 types of bulbs. With
worldwide shipping available, we can get your bulb to you no matter where you call home. We carry
all of the leading brands like Osram and General Electric as well as our own economical BulbAmerica
house brand. If you're into saving money, you should also check out our vast selection of LED bulbs,
which are designed to save energy compared to standard incandescent and compact fluorescent bulbs,
thereby lowering operating costs. LED bulbs are also long-lasting, saving you money on labor and
maintenance costs.

At BulbAmerica, we carry the best selection of fixtures, bulbs, accessories and other lighting
equipment for all sorts of applications. Whether you're looking for lighting for commercial
industrial, residential or theatrical needs, you'll find the right bulb and accessories at
BulbAmerica. Are you a DJ looking to take your show on the road? Consider some of our lightweight,
portable PAR cans that can enhance the mood of your music and your audience. We also carry PAR cans
and accessories that are suitable for dramatic productions ranging from schools and small church
plays to major professional theatrical events.

security and safety lights that will deter theft and vandalism. Motion-activated flood lights and
landscaping light bulbs can also be used to illuminate walkways or stairs to protect your family or
guests from potentially painful and costly accidents. For inside the home, we have under-cabinet
lighting to illuminate those dark niches as well as chandeliers that can add a touch of elegance to
the dining area. When Christmas rolls around, shop our huge inventory of Christmas lights, trees,
wreaths and other items to light up your home with holiday cheer inside and out.

If you have an office, you can pick from scores of energy-efficient fluorescent light bulbs at
BulbAmerica. We also carry high-bay lights suitable for warehouses and commercial enterprises. Our
large selection of industrial lighting is designed to light up any work space with ease.

Got a car that needs a new brake light, headlight or any other kind of exterior or interior light?
You can find exactly the bulb you need quickly and at a low price with our easy-to-use drop-down
menu. If you need a replacement projector lamp for your multimedia projector or rear-projection TV,

convenient drop-down menu.

## BRAINSTEAM™ Formula

### Alpha-GPC

Alpha-GPC is a choline compound that may help improve cognitive function, memory, creativity,
motivation, and executive functions. Research suggests it can enhance decision-making, cognitive
speed, and attention.

### L-Tyrosine

This amino acid plays a role in cognitive function, particularly in terms of focus and
concentration.

### L-Theanine

Found naturally in tea leaves, L-theanine is an amino acid that can promote relaxation and reduce
anxiety when combined with caffeine. It works synergistically with caffeine to create a state of
calm alertness, enhancing focus without jitters or anxiety.

### Electrolytes

Essential minerals including magnesium, potassium, and sodium to keep your system firing and your
endurance rock-steady.

### 300mg Natural Caffeine

Bulkhead Energy® uses natural caffeine (300mg per can) along with its nootropic blend. This
combination can provide a clean, long-lasting energy boost without the crash associated with sugary
energy drinks.

## BRAINSTEAM™ Formula

### Alpha-GPC

Alpha-GPC is a choline compound that may help improve cognitive function, memory, creativity,
motivation, and executive functions. Research suggests it can enhance decision-making, cognitive
speed, and attention.

### L-Tyrosine

This amino acid plays a role in cognitive function, particularly in terms of focus and
concentration.

### L-Theanine

Found naturally in tea leaves, L-theanine is an amino acid that can promote relaxation and reduce
anxiety when combined with caffeine. It works synergistically with caffeine to create a state of
calm alertness, enhancing focus without jitters or anxiety.

### Electrolytes

Essential minerals including magnesium, potassium, and sodium to keep your system firing and your
endurance rock-steady.

### 300mg Natural Caffeine

Bulkhead Energy® uses natural caffeine (300mg per can) along with its nootropic blend. This
combination can provide a clean, long-lasting energy boost without the crash associated with sugary
energy drinks.

controlling every office environment and fixture from a single, intuitive platform: LightingOS.

# Cisun Lighting – Wholesale LED lights for commercial and industrial uses

Do you still use old-school light bulbs for night illumination and are afraid of electricity bills?
Knock it off! Make your residential building or business center shine bright like a Christmas tree
all night long by installing LED lights by Cisun Lighting. They can save you a bundle, reducing
energy consumption by over 85%! And no, you don’t have to fork out for them. As a reputable Chinese
LED lighting company, we provide façade, architectural, landscape, and other lighting solutions at
wholesale prices. 

Whether you want to bring efficient light to your shopping mall, hospital, or any other facility,
you can get it here. Our lights are available in curb appeal-boosting designs and extravagant yet
cost-efficient styles. They are perfect for indoor and outdoor uses to resist the elements and years
of everyday switch-ons.

## Advantage of LED Lighting

LED lights offer numerous advantages over traditional lighting solutions. Here are some key
benefits:
* **1. Long Lifespan :** LED lights can last up to 50,000 hours or more, significantly longer than
  incandescent and fluorescent bulbs.
* **2. Energy Efficiency :** LEDs use at least 75% less energy than incandescent bulbs, which
  translates to lower electricity bills and reduced environmental impact.
* **3. Improved Safety :** LEDs emit very little heat compared to traditional bulbs, reducing the
  risk of burns and fires.
* **4. High-Quality Light :** LEDs provide bright, high-quality light that can enhance visibility
  and aesthetics.
* **5. Cost-Effective :** The long lifespan and energy savings make LEDs a cost-effective lighting
  solution in the long run.

[advantage-img]
[advantage-img]
* **6. Environmentally Friendly :** LEDs do not contain harmful substances like mercury, making them
  safer for the environment.
* **7. Durability :** LEDs are more resistant to shocks, vibrations, and external impacts, making
  them suitable for various applications.
* **8. Design Flexibility :** LEDs can be designed in various shapes and sizes, offering greater
  flexibility in lighting design.
* **9. Dimming Capability :** Many LED lights can be dimmed, allowing for greater control over
  lighting levels and energy usage.

These benefits make LED lights an excellent choice for both residential and commercial lighting
needs. If you have any specific questions or need further details, feel free to ask!

### Why Choose Us

We follow the principle of Make in India and serve the nation by processing most of the raw material
available in India.
We make energy efficient yet economical products with the help of latest technology & innovations.

## Advantage of LED Lighting

LED lights offer numerous advantages over traditional lighting solutions. Here are some key
benefits:
* **1. Long Lifespan :** LED lights can last up to 50,000 hours or more, significantly longer than
  incandescent and fluorescent bulbs.
* **2. Energy Efficiency :** LEDs use at least 75% less energy than incandescent bulbs, which
  translates to lower electricity bills and reduced environmental impact.
* **3. Improved Safety :** LEDs emit very little heat compared to traditional bulbs, reducing the
  risk of burns and fires.
* **4. High-Quality Light :** LEDs provide bright, high-quality light that can enhance visibility
  and aesthetics.
* **5. Cost-Effective :** The long lifespan and energy savings make LEDs a cost-effective lighting
  solution in the long run.

[advantage-img]
[advantage-img]
* **6. Environmentally Friendly :** LEDs do not contain harmful substances like mercury, making them
  safer for the environment.
* **7. Durability :** LEDs are more resistant to shocks, vibrations, and external impacts, making
  them suitable for various applications.
* **8. Design Flexibility :** LEDs can be designed in various shapes and sizes, offering greater
  flexibility in lighting design.
* **9. Dimming Capability :** Many LED lights can be dimmed, allowing for greater control over
  lighting levels and energy usage.

These benefits make LED lights an excellent choice for both residential and commercial lighting
needs. If you have any specific questions or need further details, feel free to ask!

* **IP Testing :** For testing LED products immunity against various outdoor and extreme weather
  conditions.

**About Us**

Encouraged by the awareness of the human society towards the selection and use of adequate Lighting
System in life, **Homdec Lighting (India) Pvt. Ltd.** initiated the manufacturing of lighting
Fixtures in 1984 and has nearly three decades of experience in this field of Lighting.

Homdec is owned and run by experienced technical professionals, hence, we are known for our
capability for innovation and Quality.

Homdec has been manufacturing luminaries for Indoor and Outdoor application for nearly three
decades. We have supplied lighting fixtures in the domestic market for:
* Wall
* Ceiling
* Gate
* Garden
* Steps
* Street etc

Our core values are:
* Expertise

### Landscape Irrigation

Founded in 1981, Hunter Industries is a global manufacturer of products for the irrigation sector.
We offer a complete spectrum of water- and energy-efficient solutions for residential, commercial,
municipal, and agricultural applications. Our core mission will always remain the same: to deliver
valued products and services backed by unwavering customer support.

[Visit Site][38]
×
[Hunter]

### Golf

Hunter Industries has been on the forefront of golf course irrigation technology for more than three
decades. We build performance, reliability, and serviceability into every product. From
industry-leading rotor technology to intuitive irrigation control software, we take pride in
providing golf professionals the tools and support they need to conceptualize, create, and manage
world-class golf courses.

[Visit Site][39]
×
[FX Luminaire]

### Landscape & Architectural Lighting

FX Luminaire is an industry-leading manufacturer of landscape and architectural lighting solutions.
We focus on the advancement of LED technology and digital lighting control with smart home
integration and zoning, dimming, and color generation capabilities. We offer a full spectrum of
lighting fixtures and accessories to create elegant landscape lighting systems for commercial and
residential applications.

[Visit Site][40]
×
[Lumascape]

### Architectural & Facade Lighting

Lumascape transforms spaces with precision-engineered lighting solutions proven to perform. Since
1991, customers have relied on us to solve their toughest lighting challenges. Our global experts
combine sophisticated design, advanced technologies, quality materials, and rigorous testing to
manufacture comprehensive lighting systems that consistently exceed performance expectations.

[Visit Site][41]
×
[Hunter]

### Agricultural Irrigation

Hunter® Agricultural Irrigation is a leading designer and manufacturer of quality Senninger®
irrigation solutions for agricultural, horticultural, and industrial applications. Our global
experts in the field work with growers to help us develop products with real irrigation solutions
that use as little water and energy as possible to make the most of every drop. With over 6 decades
of experience in more than 90 countries worldwide, Senninger products are among the most trusted in
the irrigation industry.

[Visit Site][42]
×

### Dispensing Technologies

As the original inventors of the away-from-home dispensing category, Dispensing Dynamics is proud to
continue a longstanding tradition of innovation with a range of dispensing systems that offer
unsurpassed reliability, design, performance, hygiene, and sustainability.

[Visit Site][43]
×
[Hunter]

Hunter Custom Manufacturing is an integrated division of Hunter Industries. We provide customers
with state-of-the-art manufacturing solutions, tooling, quality control, and global logistics. We
are an ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 Rev D certified company. Our logistics team delivers finished goods
around the world.

[About][45]

### Who We Are

We provide top-quality solutions for a range of sectors worldwide

Hunter Industries is a global, family-owned company that provides innovative solutions of the
highest quality for the irrigation, outdoor lighting, dispensing technology, and custom
manufacturing industries. Our products are found everywhere from residential landscapes, commercial
complexes, and golf courses to stadiums, national landmarks, and municipal buildings worldwide.
Whether you’re from New York, Shanghai, Sydney, Paris, Moscow, Buenos Aires, or Cairo, you’ve
probably encountered a Hunter product somewhere along the way.

[Learn More][46]
[[About Hunter Industries]][47]
 
[Great Ideas][48]

### Innovation Is the Cornerstone of Hunter Industries

Welcome to the Great Ideas innovation website for Hunter Industries. We created this portal to
manage innovation development within Hunter Industries and invite you to join our efforts. From new
product development and product enhancements to sustainability and manufacturing, we want to hear
from you!

[Learn More][49]
[[Great Ideas]][50]
[[Social Responsibility]][51]
[Social Responsibility][52]

### Advancing Growth with Purpose

At Hunter, our core value of Social Responsibility guides us to make decisions today that create a
better tomorrow — especially as we grow. That’s why we’re committed to pursuing clear Sustainability
and Social Impact goals that help us balance the well-being of people, the health of the planet, and
the success of our business. We track our progress and share key outcomes each year through our
annual Impact Report.

[Learn More][53]
[Community][54]

### A Commitment to Our Communities

To demonstrate our core values of Family and Social Responsibility, Hunter Industries has a
longstanding history of supporting the communities where our employees live, work, and play. We’re
proud to meet our commitments with charitable contributions, volunteerism, product donations, and
outreach.

[Learn More][55]

valued products and services backed by unwavering customer support.

[Visit Site][38]
×
[Hunter]

### Golf

Hunter Industries has been on the forefront of golf course irrigation technology for more than three
decades. We build performance, reliability, and serviceability into every product. From
industry-leading rotor technology to intuitive irrigation control software, we take pride in
providing golf professionals the tools and support they need to conceptualize, create, and manage
world-class golf courses.

[Visit Site][39]
×
[FX Luminaire]

### Landscape & Architectural Lighting

FX Luminaire is an industry-leading manufacturer of landscape and architectural lighting solutions.
We focus on the advancement of LED technology and digital lighting control with smart home
integration and zoning, dimming, and color generation capabilities. We offer a full spectrum of
lighting fixtures and accessories to create elegant landscape lighting systems for commercial and
residential applications.

[Visit Site][40]
×
[Lumascape]

### Architectural & Facade Lighting

Lumascape transforms spaces with precision-engineered lighting solutions proven to perform. Since
1991, customers have relied on us to solve their toughest lighting challenges. Our global experts
combine sophisticated design, advanced technologies, quality materials, and rigorous testing to
manufacture comprehensive lighting systems that consistently exceed performance expectations.

[Visit Site][41]
×
[Hunter]

### Agricultural Irrigation

Hunter® Agricultural Irrigation is a leading designer and manufacturer of quality Senninger®
irrigation solutions for agricultural, horticultural, and industrial applications. Our global
experts in the field work with growers to help us develop products with real irrigation solutions
that use as little water and energy as possible to make the most of every drop. With over 6 decades
of experience in more than 90 countries worldwide, Senninger products are among the most trusted in
the irrigation industry.

[Visit Site][42]
×
[Dispensing Dynamics]

### Dispensing Technologies

As the original inventors of the away-from-home dispensing category, Dispensing Dynamics is proud to
continue a longstanding tradition of innovation with a range of dispensing systems that offer
unsurpassed reliability, design, performance, hygiene, and sustainability.

[Visit Site][43]
×
[Hunter]

### Custom Manufacturing

Hunter Custom Manufacturing is an integrated division of Hunter Industries. We provide customers
with state-of-the-art manufacturing solutions, tooling, quality control, and global logistics. We
are an ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 Rev D certified company. Our logistics team delivers finished goods
around the world.

[Visit Site][44]
[About][45]

### Who We Are

We provide top-quality solutions for a range of sectors worldwide

Hunter Industries is a global, family-owned company that provides innovative solutions of the
highest quality for the irrigation, outdoor lighting, dispensing technology, and custom
manufacturing industries. Our products are found everywhere from residential landscapes, commercial
complexes, and golf courses to stadiums, national landmarks, and municipal buildings worldwide.
Whether you’re from New York, Shanghai, Sydney, Paris, Moscow, Buenos Aires, or Cairo, you’ve
probably encountered a Hunter product somewhere along the way.

Welcome to the Great Ideas innovation website for Hunter Industries. We created this portal to

At Hunter, our core value of Social Responsibility guides us to make decisions today that create a

ABOUT US

# Where craft meets creativity.

At Industville, we are a lighting company where craftsmanship, creativity, and sustainability shape
everything we do. As a UK-based lighting company, we design and create lighting and designer lights
for homes, hospitality, and commercial spaces.

From hand-finished designs to artist collaborations, every detail reflects our passion for enriching
interiors with timeless style. Whether you’re looking to shop statement ceiling lights, wall lights,
or buy lighting that brings character to your space, our collections combine authentic design with
lasting quality.

Trusted by thousands of customers and renowned brands such as Liberty London and Soho House, our
ethically made lighting transforms spaces into places where design and authenticity shine.

Mara Miller | Founder of Industville

[Learn More][115]

# FAQs

**What type of lighting is best for my space?**

The best lighting depends on the size, function, and style of your room. Pendant lights work
beautifully above kitchen islands and dining tables, while wall lights and table lamps help create
softer layers of ambient lighting. For lower ceilings, flush and semi-flush ceiling lights are a
practical option. Mixing different light sources usually creates the most balanced and welcoming
atmosphere. For more guides and information, visit our [Knowledge Hub][116].

**What makes Industville lighting different?**

At Industville, we focus on timeless design, quality craftsmanship, and carefully selected
materials. Our collections combine industrial, vintage, modern, and farmhouse influences, with many
designs handcrafted and hand-finished for a unique character. We also offer a wide range of
finishes, shades, and configurable options so customers can create lighting that feels personal to
their space.

**Are your lights handcrafted?**

Many of our lighting collections are handcrafted using quality materials such as solid brass,
artisan glass, natural stone, wood, and metal. Due to the handmade nature of many products, slight
variations in finish and texture can occur, making each piece unique.

**Are your lights suitable for both residential and commercial spaces?**

Yes. Our lighting collections are designed for both residential and commercial interiors, including
homes, restaurants, cafés, hotels, retail spaces, and offices. Many of our designs are popular in
hospitality settings thanks to their durability, versatility, and timeless aesthetic.

**Do you offer bespoke or custom lighting solutions?**

Yes, we offer bespoke lighting solutions across selected collections. From custom cable lengths and
finishes to tailored multi-pendant arrangements, our team can help create lighting that suits your
specific project requirements and interior style. Find out more [here][117].

**Do you offer UK-wide delivery on lighting orders?**

Yes, we offer UK-wide delivery across our lighting collections. Delivery options and lead times may
vary depending on the product type and whether the item is made to order. We also ship
internationally. Full delivery information can be found at checkout, on [this page][118], or by
contacting our team directly.

## Clerkenwell Showroom & Design Hub

Our London design hub is based in Clerkenwell EC1, within the historic Cannon Brewery building.
Designed as a relaxed place to explore our collections, discuss ideas and experience our lighting in
person, the space is open to all our customers, from homeowners to interior designers, architects
and developers.


[Find Out More][113]

## Trade Accounts

By signing up to our Trade Account you'll unlock multiple perks

Trade Pricing
Dedicated Support
Tailored Products
[Apply Now][114]
ABOUT US

# Where craft meets creativity.

At Industville, we are a lighting company where craftsmanship, creativity, and sustainability shape
everything we do. As a UK-based lighting company, we design and create lighting and designer lights
for homes, hospitality, and commercial spaces.

From hand-finished designs to artist collaborations, every detail reflects our passion for enriching
interiors with timeless style. Whether you’re looking to shop statement ceiling lights, wall lights,
or buy lighting that brings character to your space, our collections combine authentic design with
lasting quality.

Trusted by thousands of customers and renowned brands such as Liberty London and Soho House, our
ethically made lighting transforms spaces into places where design and authenticity shine.

Mara Miller | Founder of Industville

[Learn More][115]

# FAQs

**What type of lighting is best for my space?**

The best lighting depends on the size, function, and style of your room. Pendant lights work
beautifully above kitchen islands and dining tables, while wall lights and table lamps help create
softer layers of ambient lighting. For lower ceilings, flush and semi-flush ceiling lights are a
practical option. Mixing different light sources usually creates the most balanced and welcoming
atmosphere. For more guides and information, visit our [Knowledge Hub][116].

**What makes Industville lighting different?**

At Industville, we focus on timeless design, quality craftsmanship, and carefully selected
materials. Our collections combine industrial, vintage, modern, and farmhouse influences, with many
designs handcrafted and hand-finished for a unique character. We also offer a wide range of
finishes, shades, and configurable options so customers can create lighting that feels personal to
their space.

**Are your lights handcrafted?**

Many of our lighting collections are handcrafted using quality materials such as solid brass,
artisan glass, natural stone, wood, and metal. Due to the handmade nature of many products, slight
variations in finish and texture can occur, making each piece unique.

**Are your lights suitable for both residential and commercial spaces?**

Yes. Our lighting collections are designed for both residential and commercial interiors, including
homes, restaurants, cafés, hotels, retail spaces, and offices. Many of our designs are popular in
hospitality settings thanks to their durability, versatility, and timeless aesthetic.

**Do you offer bespoke or custom lighting solutions?**

Yes, we offer bespoke lighting solutions across selected collections. From custom cable lengths and
finishes to tailored multi-pendant arrangements, our team can help create lighting that suits your
specific project requirements and interior style. Find out more [here][117].

**Do you offer UK-wide delivery on lighting orders?**

Yes, we offer UK-wide delivery across our lighting collections. Delivery options and lead times may
vary depending on the product type and whether the item is made to order. We also ship
internationally. Full delivery information can be found at checkout, on [this page][118], or by
contacting our team directly.

# Kinetic Lighting

### Visual Services For Creative Minds

## LIGHTING SERVICES

[

### Equipment Rentals

Our lighting rental service offers clean, well-maintained equipment from top manufacturers. We
support corporate industrials, exhibits, studio/film/tv, concerts, live entertainment, theatres,
houses of worship, & schools.

][34][

### Sales

We sell theatrical, architectural, & studio lighting equipment — from a single product to an entire
system installation. And you’ll benefit from our field experience — we rent and use many of the
products we sell.

][35][

### Show Services

Our Show Services group provides a turnkey lighting service, complete with labor, logistics, show
prep, design support, and operation. Show Services also supports rental and sales projects that have
labor, prep, or PreViz needs.
][36][

### Systems Integration

We offer turnkey installation and integration services. If you’re looking for a complete system for
your space, our Systems Integration team can help.

][37]

### SHOW SERVICES

We offer 360˚ turnkey show support for the most demanding projects, anywhere in the U.S. Our team’s
focus is on supporting your production needs, with meticulous execution and technical excellence.

[
Learn More
][38]

### System Sales & Integration

Whether you’re upgrading an existing system or starting from scratch, you’ll be amazed at the many
benefits new lighting and [control systems][39] offer.  An investment now in cutting-edge equipment
will yield savings in energy and maintenance costs for years — All while drastically improving the
look of your space. Our systems integration includes project management, design and specification,
installation, programming and commissioning.

[
Learn More

We offer a wide range of innovative outdoor, industrial, and commercial lighting solutions, serving
streets, public spaces, sports facilities, and demanding environments like harbors and offshore

professionals across industries. With decades of experience, Lightholm delivers reliable,
solution-focused industrial lighting systems designed for both everyday use and extreme conditions,
ensuring safety, energy efficiency, and long-lasting performance.

* ### 50+ YEARS INDUSTRY EXPERTISE
  
  With roots dating back to 1973, LPP offers a wide variety of WiLL solutions for commercial,
  industrial and residential applications. WiLL's dedicated engineers, support professionals,
  problem solvers, and manufacturers provide exceptional customer service and unbeatable
  craftsmanship.
* ### PRODUCTS MADE IN AMERICA
  
  WiLL's facility proudly engineers and manufactures commercial-grade LED lights, light poles, and
  brackets in right in Fond du Lac, WI. Manufacturing in the USA gives us the ability to oversee the
  entire process, resulting in high-quality products while maintaining fast production lead times.

  Every lighting project comes with it’s own set of challenges. That’s why we’re committed to
  offering the best mix of lighting solutions and highest-grade support to our customers. Regardless

  With an extensive catalog of LED lighting, light poles, and mounting accessories, LPP is committed
  to serving the evolving needs of the lighting industry. If there are any lighting products you are

LPP offers industry best lead times for American-made, professional-grade light poles and LED light

finishing capabilities, we'll meet your project's timeline and product specs.

## Why Choose Light Poles Plus?
* ### 50+ YEARS INDUSTRY EXPERTISE
  
  With roots dating back to 1973, LPP offers a wide variety of WiLL solutions for commercial,
  industrial and residential applications. WiLL's dedicated engineers, support professionals,
  problem solvers, and manufacturers provide exceptional customer service and unbeatable
  craftsmanship.
* ### PRODUCTS MADE IN AMERICA
  
  WiLL's facility proudly engineers and manufactures commercial-grade LED lights, light poles, and
  brackets in right in Fond du Lac, WI. Manufacturing in the USA gives us the ability to oversee the
  entire process, resulting in high-quality products while maintaining fast production lead times.
* ### CUSTOM ENGINEERING & PROCUREMENT
  
  Every lighting project comes with it’s own set of challenges. That’s why we’re committed to
  offering the best mix of lighting solutions and highest-grade support to our customers. Regardless
  of your project criteria, our design team will create the perfect lighting package.
* ### 1000s OF PRODUCT OPTIONS
  
  With an extensive catalog of LED lighting, light poles, and mounting accessories, LPP is committed
  to serving the evolving needs of the lighting industry. If there are any lighting products you are
  looking for that you don’t find on our website, contact our project team.

# Complete Power Control, Simplified.

From circuit breaker panels to rack power and sequencing, LynTec delivers intelligent, reliable
power control for every AV and lighting system.
[ Explore Products ][161]
[ Find a Representative ][162]
TRUSTED BY 13,000+ INSTALLATIONS WORLDWIDE
Madison Square GardenLincoln CenterKennedy CenterPixar AnimationNASAGoldman SachsMITWillow Creek
Madison Square GardenLincoln CenterKennedy CenterPixar AnimationNASAGoldman SachsMITWillow Creek
WHY LYNTEC

## One Brand.
## Every Power Solution.

Integrator-firstCode-compliantBuilt for reliability
LynTec simplifies complex AV and lighting systems by combining proven electrical reliability with
intelligent control. From centralized breaker panels to remote rack power and UPS protection, our
unified ecosystem gives integrators and engineers total visibility, safety, and confidence in their
power infrastructure.

## The LynTec Power Ecosystem

Every level of your power system: connected, protected, and easy to control.
* ### AVL Ecosystem
  
  Breaker panels with remote switching are the foundation of reliable audio, video, and lighting
  power control for touring rigs, houses of worship, and studios.
  
  FEATURES
  * Remote-controlled breaker panels Centralized, switchable power for AVL systems
  * Integrated DMX + Ethernet control Native lighting console and network integration
  * UL-listed, code-compliant Built for install and touring under strict safety codes
  SERIES [RPC][163] [RPCR][164]
  [Explore AVL Ecosystem →][165]
* ### Lighting Ecosystem
  
  DMX-enabled lighting control panels are the foundation of precise stage, studio, and architectural
  lighting power for theaters, broadcast facilities, and live venues.
  
  FEATURES
  * Circuit-level DMX control LCP series for direct console-to-breaker integration
  * Built-in sequencing logic LC and MS series for safe, staged power-up
  * Scalable modular design Expandable panels that grow with your rig
  SERIES [LC][166] [LCP][167] [MS][168]
  [Explore Lighting Ecosystem →][169]
* ### Standalone Ecosystem
  
  Rackmount and portable power controllers are the foundation of flexible, network-ready power
  management for distributed AV, broadcast, and touring systems.
  
  FEATURES
  * Network-based switching NPAC + XPC series for IP-driven power control
  * Multi-circuit relay control XRS modules for high-density rack environments
  * Compact form factor XRM modules for tight installs and mobile racks
  SERIES [NPAC][170] [XPC][171]
  [Explore Standalone Ecosystem →][172]
* ### Power Conditioning & Surge Protection
  
  Filtering and surge suppression is the foundation of equipment safety for broadcast studios,
  performance venues, and mission-critical AV systems.
  
  FEATURES
  * Advanced power conditioning RX series for clean, regulated AV power
  * Scalable panel protection SGX and SPD series for whole-system defense
  * Noise-free isolation Transformers that eliminate ground loops and interference
  SERIES [RX][173] [SGX][174] [SPD][175]
  [Explore Power Conditioning & Surge Protection →][176]
* ### Power Sequencing & Remote Control
  
  Automated sequencing and networked remote control is the foundation of safe system startup for
  houses of worship, performance venues, and corporate AV.
  
  FEATURES
  * Time-delayed sequencing CQ and SQ series for inrush current protection
  * Ethernet-based automation IP series for remote and scheduled control
  * Wall-mount activation RC and RT remotes for one-touch system power
  SERIES [CQ][177] [IP][178] [RC][179] [RT][180] [SQ][181]
  [Explore Power Sequencing & Remote Control →][182]
* ### Rack Power Distribution
  
  Rack-level power distribution is the foundation of organized, protected AV power delivery for
  broadcast racks, equipment rooms, and production carts.
  
  FEATURES
  * Sequenced rack strips JG series for surge-protected, staged power-on
  * Vertical rack mounting PD series for clean cable management in tall racks
  * Pro-grade build quality Engineered for 24/7 broadcast and touring use
  SERIES [JG][183] [PD][184]
  [Explore Rack Power Distribution →][185]
* ### Value Relay Boxes & Retrofit Control
  
  Affordable relay panels are the foundation of cost-effective AV upgrades for small venues, legacy
  systems, and retrofit lighting installations.
  
  FEATURES
  * DMX or contact-closure control LCRP series for simple console-driven switching
  * Plug-and-play distribution PDS series for fast retrofit deployment
  * Budget-friendly footprint Reliable performance without panel-level investment
  SERIES [LCRP][186] [PDS][187]
  [Explore Value Relay Boxes & Retrofit Control →][188]
* ### Support Hardware & Accessories
  
  Safety switches, UPS backup, and connectivity accessories are the foundation of complete,
  code-compliant AV power systems for any LynTec installation.
  
  FEATURES
  * Lockable safety disconnects SS, KS, and CS switches for code compliance
  * Battery backup protection SL, KIN, SRA, and SCV UPS systems for uptime
  * Connectivity + upgrades XLR accessories, TC/TVS modules, and certified upgrade kits
  SERIES [KIN][189] [SCV][190] [SL][191] [SRA][192] [TC][193] [Upgrade Kit][194] [XLR
  Accessories][195]
  [Explore Support Hardware & Accessories →][196]

  Used to store the user's login session

  3 months
  
  Google cookie to ensure session data is only transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections.
* __Secure-STRP
  
  5 hours
  
  Google cookie to maintain secure, authenticated sessions.
* AEC
  
  5 months
  
  Google cookie to ensure that requests in a browsing session are made by the user and not by

* _GRECAPTCHA

  Google cookie to distinguish between human users and automated bots.

Zeitlos, bildschön und in großer Auswahl: Bei uns finden Sie ein sorgfältig kuratiertes Sortiment an
klassischen und historischen Außenleuchten. Wir helfen Ihnen gerne, die richtige Leuchte für Haus,
Garten oder Hof zu finden.

#### Beständig

Seit Jahren arbeiten wir mit erfahrenen Außenleuchten-Manufakturen aus Deutschland und europäischen
Nachbarländern. In bester handwerklicher Tradition werden dort oft schon seit mehr als 100 Jahren
Leuchten hergestellt.

#### Fachkundig

Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen in zweiter Generation aus Augsburg. Unsere Erfahrung im
Leuchtenfachhandel macht uns zu kompetenten Partnern für Ihr Leuchtenprojekt. Wir bieten Beratung
und Service für Privatkunden, Gewerbe und Gastronomie.

#### Ausgesucht

Zeitlos, bildschön und in großer Auswahl: Bei uns finden Sie ein sorgfältig kuratiertes Sortiment an
klassischen und historischen Außenleuchten. Wir helfen Ihnen gerne, die richtige Leuchte für Haus,
Garten oder Hof zu finden.

#### Beständig

Seit Jahren arbeiten wir mit erfahrenen Außenleuchten-Manufakturen aus Deutschland und europäischen
Nachbarländern. In bester handwerklicher Tradition werden dort oft schon seit mehr als 100 Jahren
Leuchten hergestellt.

## [Enhance Your Home’s Curb Appeal With A Door Step Cover][3]

[July 16, 2026][4] / [Willard Schmidt][5]

When it comes to enhancing the exterior of your home, every detail matters. From the landscaping to
the front door, each element plays a crucial role in creating a welcoming and polished look. One
often overlooked aspect of the home’s exterior is the door step. However, with the addition of a
door step cover, you can not only protect your step but also add a stylish touch to your entryway.

A door step cover is a simple yet effective way to improve the functionality and aesthetics of your
home’s entrance. These covers are designed to fit over the existing step, providing protection
against wear and tear while also adding a decorative element to your doorstep. They come in a
variety of materials, styles, and colors, making it easy to find one that complements your home’s
exterior design.

One of the main benefits of a door step cover is that it helps to prevent damage to your step.
Constant exposure to the elements, such as rain, snow, and sunlight, can cause the step to
deteriorate over time. By installing a cover, you can shield your step from these elements,
prolonging its lifespan and reducing the need for repairs or replacements.

build the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in their degree program.

develop their mathematical skills, ensuring that they have the necessary tools to excel in their

research skills, students are provided with the support and guidance they need to thrive in a

Overall, a foundation year in physics is an invaluable opportunity for students to explore the world

grounding in the fundamental principles of the subject, developing their problem-solving and

# Home

# Sheet metal fabrication for businesses

We produce sheet metal parts and assemblies that OEMs rely on
* turnkey solutions
* 100 to millions of units
* small to medium size parts

[ Upload your files ][161]
[ [metal stamped part] ][162]

### Metal Stamping

With 100+ presses, 1600+ open-tooled dies and expert in-house toolroom, Tripar’s capabilities
include progressive stamping, blanking, punching, bending, engraving, marking, embossing, rolling,
drawing and deep drawing. For high volumes and the lowest possible unit cost.

[ Learn more ][163]
[ [High precision CNC machine] ][164]

### CNC Fabrication

With Tripar’s vast CNC capabilities and experience, we manufacture a wide range of sheet metal
components through laser cutting, punching, bending, forming, spot welding, shearing, riveting,
clinch joining and assemblies too. For low volumes and fastest lead times.

[ Learn more ][165]

## Serving 350+ clients in US, Canada, Europe

[ ][166]

### [ Recessed Lighting ][167]

[Full line of stocked items][168]: IC Boxes, plaster frames, driver boxes, brackets, bar hangers,
and more.

### HVAC/R

Manufacture diffusers, grills, faceplates, louvers, housings, brackets, hinges, nameplates, etc.

### Warehouse Racking

Metal components like shims, brackets and support systems for new and existing warehouses.

### Consumer Goods

Central vacuums, extractor fans, storage cases, covers, trays, various components, etc.

### Aerospace

Many years producing engraving plates, heat shields, shielding cans and washers, and more.

## Design & Engineering

We offer design and engineering services for all your sheet metal components: Design for
Manufacturability (DFM), 3D modelling,  technical drawings, optimizations, and prototyping.

[ Learn more ][169]

## Knowledgeable Team

Tripar is a family business with 75+ years. We proudly manufacture everything under one roof with
our incredibly talented and knowledgeable team. 

[ Learn more ][170]

### The Tripar Advantage

### Optimize your production

Unlike most suppliers, we are not tied to a single fabrication method. Based on part complexity and
annual volumes, we will seamlessly migrate you from CNC fabrication, to hybrid manufacturing (combo
of CNC and stamping), to metal stamping. No need to worry if you're overpaying as quantities
increase.

We help you optimize your sheet metal fabrication needs. From design, engineering, die design &
build, prototyping, fabrication, QA&QC, painting, assembly, packaging, and shipping - we do it all.

# Home

# Sheet metal fabrication for businesses

We produce sheet metal parts and assemblies that OEMs rely on
* turnkey solutions
* 100 to millions of units
* small to medium size parts

[ Upload your files ][161]
[ [metal stamped part] ][162]

### Metal Stamping

With 100+ presses, 1600+ open-tooled dies and expert in-house toolroom, Tripar’s capabilities
include progressive stamping, blanking, punching, bending, engraving, marking, embossing, rolling,
drawing and deep drawing. For high volumes and the lowest possible unit cost.

[ Learn more ][163]
[ [High precision CNC machine] ][164]

### CNC Fabrication

With Tripar’s vast CNC capabilities and experience, we manufacture a wide range of sheet metal
components through laser cutting, punching, bending, forming, spot welding, shearing, riveting,
clinch joining and assemblies too. For low volumes and fastest lead times.

[ Learn more ][165]

## Serving 350+ clients in US, Canada, Europe

[ ][166]

### [ Recessed Lighting ][167]

[Full line of stocked items][168]: IC Boxes, plaster frames, driver boxes, brackets, bar hangers,
and more.

### HVAC/R

Manufacture diffusers, grills, faceplates, louvers, housings, brackets, hinges, nameplates, etc.

### Warehouse Racking

Metal components like shims, brackets and support systems for new and existing warehouses.

### Consumer Goods

Central vacuums, extractor fans, storage cases, covers, trays, various components, etc.

### Aerospace

Many years producing engraving plates, heat shields, shielding cans and washers, and more.

## Design & Engineering

We offer design and engineering services for all your sheet metal components: Design for
Manufacturability (DFM), 3D modelling,  technical drawings, optimizations, and prototyping.

[ Learn more ][169]

## Knowledgeable Team

Tripar is a family business with 75+ years. We proudly manufacture everything under one roof with
our incredibly talented and knowledgeable team. 

[ Learn more ][170]

### The Tripar Advantage

### Optimize your production

Unlike most suppliers, we are not tied to a single fabrication method. Based on part complexity and
annual volumes, we will seamlessly migrate you from CNC fabrication, to hybrid manufacturing (combo
of CNC and stamping), to metal stamping. No need to worry if you're overpaying as quantities
increase.

We help you optimize your sheet metal fabrication needs. From design, engineering, die design &
build, prototyping, fabrication, QA&QC, painting, assembly, packaging, and shipping - we do it all.

Industrial Lighting Solutions at Westgate Mfg.

Industrial Lighting Products:

Industrial High Bay Lights: Illuminate vast industrial spaces with efficiency suitable for utility
rebates with all the necessary controls.
Industrial Flood Lights: Robust lighting for high-intensity tasks, and enduring heat waves, and
operating during cold weather.
Industrial Task Lighting: Precision-focused lights for intricate processes.

Industrial High Bay Lights:

size. These lights are designed to cater to large areas with high ceilings and provide consistent

blend of cutting-edge LED technology and innovative design, they promise both brightness and
significant energy savings.

Industrial Flood Lights:

broad-beamed light, these are ideal for outdoor spaces, security, parking lots, and specific task
areas within industries. Made with robust materials, they are resistant to adverse weather
conditions and provide focused and intense light where you need it the most. Their durability
ensures that they stand firm, even in the most demanding environments, making them a favorite among
industries that run around the clock.

clear lighting to ensure perfection, no matter how intricate or detailed. Our Task Lights are
designed to provide targeted illumination, ensuring every detail stands out. They are adjustable,
allowing you to focus light exactly where needed. Ideal for workstations, assembly lines, and
inspection areas, they guarantee that every job is done under optimal lighting conditions.

your workspace is lit exactly as you envision with the goal of maximizing efficiency and ROI.

waiting to be painted with light. Our extensive range of residential LED lighting products has been
meticulously designed to enhance the aesthetics of your living spaces and maximize energy
efficiency. Whether you're seeking warm and cozy lighting for a living room or bright, task-oriented
lighting for a kitchen, our collection caters to diverse preferences and requirements.

Why Choose Westgate's Residential LED Lighting:

**Efficiency at its Finest: **Our **residential LED lighting** solutions merge exceptional
brightness with remarkable energy efficiency. Enjoy brilliant lighting that consumes significantly
less energy than traditional lighting, reducing electricity bills.
**Longevity and Durability:** We prioritize longevity. Our LED lights are built to last, reducing
the need for frequent replacements. This saves you money in the long run and contributes to a
sustainable lifestyle.
**Customized Ambiance:** Discover the power to set the mood in every room. Our range includes
various color temperatures, selectable via a built-in switch, dimming, and control options, allowing
you to create the perfect ambiance for relaxation, productivity, or entertainment.

Commercial LED Lighting Solutions:

In an era where businesses strive to stand out, lighting is pivotal in creating an inviting and
professional atmosphere. Westgate Manufacturing takes pride in offering various commercial LED
lighting solutions that elevate spaces, optimize operations, and lead to substantial energy savings.

Commercial LED Lighting:

Regarding commercial spaces, lighting is more than just illumination; it's a statement. Our
commercial LED lighting products redefine how businesses present themselves to clients, customers,
and employees. From retail establishments to offices, warehouses, and beyond, our lighting solutions
are engineered to enhance functionality and aesthetics.

Why opt for Westgate's Commercial LED Lighting:

**Energy Efficiency Redefined:** Traditional lighting systems can account for a significant portion
of a business's energy consumption. Our commercial LED lighting drastically reduces this energy
usage, translating into cost savings that directly impact your bottom line.
**Quality and Reliability:** We understand the importance of uninterrupted operations. Our
commercial LED lighting products are designed for robustness, minimizing downtime and
maintenance-related disruptions.
**Tailored Solutions:** Every business is unique, and so are its lighting needs. Our commercial LED
lighting range encompasses a wide variety of fixtures, styles, and brightness levels to cater to
your specific requirements. Paired with essential add-ons such as Emergency battery backup, NLC
sensors, Photocell, IOT connectivity and customer color powder coating.
**Shaping Brighter, Efficient Tomorrows:**Westgate Manufacturing is more than a provider of LED
lighting solutions; we're architects of energy-efficient futures. With a commitment to quality,
innovation, and above-the-standard profitability for the customer, we illuminate both residential
and commercial spaces, setting the standard for lighting excellence. Explore our collection now and
embark on a journey towards brilliance, efficiency, and a greener world.

Industrial Lighting Solutions at Westgate Mfg.

At Westgate Mfg., we understand that every industrial space requires efficient, durable, and
superior lighting, whether it’s a factory, warehouse, or workshop. We have been at the forefront of
delivering unparalleled industrial lighting solutions for years.

Industrial Lighting Products:

Experience a spectrum of excellence with our wide range of industrial lighting products. Engineered
to perfection, our lights ensure optimal illumination, energy efficiency, and long-lasting
performance.
Industrial High Bay Lights: Illuminate vast industrial spaces with efficiency suitable for utility
rebates with all the necessary controls.
Industrial Flood Lights: Robust lighting for high-intensity tasks, and enduring heat waves, and
operating during cold weather.
Industrial Task Lighting: Precision-focused lights for intricate processes.

Industrial High Bay Lights:

You can elevate your workspace with our High Bay Lights, available in linear, UFO style, or compact
size. These lights are designed to cater to large areas with high ceilings and provide consistent
and shadow-free illumination. Whether it's a manufacturing plant or a warehouse, our High Bay Lights
ensure every corner is vividly lit, reducing strain on the eyes and improving productivity. With a
blend of cutting-edge LED technology and innovative design, they promise both brightness and
significant energy savings.

Industrial Flood Lights:

Illuminate the essentials with Westgate Mfg.’s Flood Lights. Known for their high-intensity and
broad-beamed light, these are ideal for outdoor spaces, security, parking lots, and specific task
areas within industries. Made with robust materials, they are resistant to adverse weather
conditions and provide focused and intense light where you need it the most. Their durability
ensures that they stand firm, even in the most demanding environments, making them a favorite among
industries that run around the clock.

Industrial Task Lighting:

Precision, clarity, and efficiency define our range of Task Lighting solutions. Every task requires
clear lighting to ensure perfection, no matter how intricate or detailed. Our Task Lights are
designed to provide targeted illumination, ensuring every detail stands out. They are adjustable,
allowing you to focus light exactly where needed. Ideal for workstations, assembly lines, and
inspection areas, they guarantee that every job is done under optimal lighting conditions.

Customized Industrial Lighting Solutions:

Need something specific? At Westgate Mfg., we cater to tailored industrial lighting needs, ensuring
your workspace is lit exactly as you envision with the goal of maximizing efficiency and ROI.

# Electrical Wholesale Suppliers - Trade & Public

At YESSS Electrical, we stock everything from plug sockets to smart home devices. With over 10,000
products sourced from the UK’s leading electrical brands, we offer competitive prices and all the
electrical supplies you’ll ever need regardless of your project or budget.

Shop the biggest brands and get FREE mainland UK delivery when you spend £50 or more. Choose from
our wide range of industry standard electrical fittings that include:
* [Lamps and Tubes][66]
* [Light Fittings][67]
* [Wiring Accessories][68]
* [Switchgear & Distribution][69]
* [Industrial Controls][70]
* [Cable][71] and [Cable Management][72]
* [EV Charging & Renewables][73]
* [Smart Homes and Data][74]
* [Heating, Hygiene and Ventilation][75]
* [Fire, Security and Access][76]
* [Tool, Workwear & Fixings][77]

All of our products are housed at our distribution centre in West Yorkshire. Our fleet provides next
day delivery to our local stores, offering you fast and flexible delivery options to suit your
business or lifestyle. To find your ideal electrical product, simply type a product code or the
item’s details into the search bar. Alternatively, you can browse our category pages to find exactly
what you’re looking for!

With 100 stores nationwide open to both trade and public customers, we are the fastest growing
electrical wholesaler in the country and the first stop for all your electrical supplies, services
and solutions. [**Click here**][78] to find your nearest store.
